name: RC21 H1: Mean+Residual Decomposition
theory: Separate conditional mean from stochastic residual. Oracle debiasing proved spread adequate, centering wrong.
result: 165a (hard centering) 4/9 — killed persistence. 165a_v2 (additive innov) 6/9 S2 PASS but S3 FAIL. 165a_v3 (spatial mean head) 5/9 — overfits. Mean head approach has S2/S3 tension. Deeper issue: CRPS drift-blindness causes decoder under-reversion at 50% GT speed.

name: RC21 H1v4: Direct Ensemble Mean MSE (loss-only fix)
theory: CRPS is drift-blind. Add MSE on ensemble mean directly to loss.
target: S2 PASS + S3 still PASS + total >= 7/9
result: 165b: S3 improved (+17pp) but S2 WORSENED (0.046→0.062). Ensemble mean MSE compresses spread through shared decoder params — centering and spread compete. Not a fundamental impossibility, but a shared-parameter capacity allocation issue.

name: RC21 H1v5: Corrected IS + Ensemble Mean MSE (combined loss fix)
theory: Gradient decomposition revealed TWO independent issues: (1) IS at lambda=0.05 consumes 42% of gradient (should be ~10%), starving CRPS. (2) CRPS itself allocates only 13% of gradient to centering (spread 2.9x dominant). Fix both simultaneously: correct IS to lambda=0.005 (10% budget) AND add ensemble mean MSE for centering. Two loss-function changes on the baseline architecture, no mean head.
target: S2 PASS + S3 PASS + S4/S5/S9 preserved + total >= 7/9
implementation: Baseline softplus training script with: (1) lambda_is=0.005 (from 0.05), (2) lambda_center via gradient matching at 10% budget on the corrected-IS model. No architecture change.
kill_condition: S3/S5/S9 regress (spread damaged) OR no improvement over baseline 6/9.
if_fails: CRPS centering/spread ratio (1:2.9) is the structural bottleneck. Need a different scoring rule (DSS, LogScore) or architecture separation.
evidence: Gradient decomposition: CRPS spread 2.9x centering, IS 42% of gradient at lambda=0.05, stochastic pathway alive (sole diversity source), K=16 under-samples distribution (K=100 → 82.7% coverage vs 75.8%). 165b showed centering MSE fixes S3 but compresses spread. Correcting IS first gives CRPS more budget, then centering MSE adds the missing signal.

name: RC21 H2: Contrastive Regime Loss on Encoder
theory: InfoNCE on encoder bottleneck pushes conditions from different VoV quintiles apart. Weakened rationale: verification showed encoder signal IS used (83.5% window-specific output). But stronger encoder signal could still help per-cell precision.
target: S7 L2 >= 3/8. Encoder probe accuracy improvement.
implementation: InfoNCE loss on encoder bottleneck. Positives = same VoV quintile.
kill_condition: Probe accuracy doesn't improve AND shuffle-cond MAE doesn't increase.
if_fails: Encoder architecture lacks capacity. Move to H4.

name: RC21 H4: Spatial Inductive Bias in Encoder
theory: GRU sees flat 25-vector, losing spatial structure. Spatial encoder could extract regime info more efficiently from 4010 windows.
target: Encoder linear probe accuracy improvement. S2/S7 proxy improvement.
kill_condition: Neither bigger GRU nor spatial encoder improves probes.

name: RC21 H5: Per-cell Quantile Auxiliary Head
theory: Pinball loss on q05/q50/q95 per cell gives direct gradients on tails.
kill_condition: Auxiliary loss improves but KS-levels doesn't.
